title: Fired for taking tea, biscuits from office: Jharkhand HC orders peon’s reinstatement
summary: A Jharkhand court has ordered the reinstatement of a peon sacked for taking office tea and biscuits home. The court deemed the dismissal "grossly disproportionate," highlighting a vague show-cause notice and the lack of consideration for his plea.
